name: Bloodfest
doc: Bloodfest (Seifer's enemy attack 315, c0m128): flames around the targets, afterimages of the entity after the caster with the blade trail of slot 4's bone 1, a rising layout and a mesh at the caster's bone, the stage captured into VRAM and a vortex at the targets' centre, the targets lifted spinning and drawn by the module over the burning layout with a burst of sparkles and rocks, then dropped from above under the drop layout with falling rocks (the caster hidden), put back and raised; an end layout at each target, the white flash, the screen flash, the sounds; the action results at tick 0xF3. Demon Slice 251's twin. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag210_bloodfest.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer); its texture is exe data (the setup's TIM), its file loader the engine's bare ret.

parts.doc: Flames around each target (Fire's parts), each with its ground glow, embers rising and sparks drifting

parts.doc: Afterimages of the entity after the caster (the last two recorded poses, the newer brighter), in two windows

parts.doc: A mesh at the caster's bone, stretched to the ground, turning, fading in

parts.title: Vortex
parts.doc: The stage captured into VRAM, then a vortex at the targets' centre (a ring pushed out and quads of the capture's texture growing in, a second one turned and rolled), fading out

parts.title: Targets
parts.doc: The targets lifted spinning (a sine, then a cubic fall), then dropped from above, drawn by the module

parts.title: Burning layout
parts.doc: The burning layout at the targets' centre while they are lifted (its textures scrolling); a burst of sparkles and rocks on its first ticks

parts.title: Drop
parts.doc: The drop layout at the targets' centre while they fall (the caster and the next entity hidden), rocks falling a few a tick; then the targets put back and raised

parts.title: End layouts
parts.doc: A layout at each target's feet as the results come

parts.title: White flash
parts.doc: A full-screen flash (fading in, held, fading out)

parts.title: Blade trail
parts.doc: The blade trail of slot 4's bone 1: a ring of its last 7 points splined, drawn as gouraud quads fading along it

parts.title: Rocks
parts.doc: Rocks (a mesh) turning, rising then falling

parts.title: Sparkles
parts.doc: Sparkles rising from a ring round the targets' centre
